Forward ackTick through loopSpawnRunner, export it for a regression test that drives the real default runner (not an injected substitute) through a full request/ack round trip. Store dir ~/.local/share/gos/85af56a090a78924 is live dogfood evidence — never delete, reset, or overwrite it.
